para: Select_by_Aspect_Ratio selects all &elems; which have aspect ratios greater than the given threshold. See for the definition of aspect ratio.

If only_quads is True, then triangular elements will not be selected. If only_refineable is True, only quads that whose longest edges are not adjacent to one another will be selected. These two settings allow Select_by_Aspect_Ratio to select only the elements that would be refined with .
